title: Seat geometry and anchor-zone model (RAS-2 and RAS-3)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/design/geometry/side_view.png is a 2D concept. Seat designers need the anchor zones and keep-out zones relative to the seat reference point in 3D. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Model a generic seat with the H-point, side anchor zones (45–75° tether window), RAS-3 center anchor zone and primary-restraint keep-out zone as parametric volumes.
acceptanceCriteria: Generic seat, no real manufacturer geometry
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
